question: E68 Amendment 1: can the pass test pass anything? No placement of an update has reached its faithful line. The ceiling is W0's masked forward with the whole update added, no mask on it, at every site.

quantities.ceiling: at each of the 196 matrices the output is ((x V) * g) U + x dW^T, g from Gamma on W0's forward, U, V W0's, Delta off
quantities.K_C: KL(FT || ceiling), mean over every position, same rows as E68
quantities.K_Z: the same forward with the added term multiplied by 0: must equal E68's KD
quantities.K_clean_plus: KL(FT || W0 clean + x dW^T through the same hook), no masks, first 8 rows of u1
quantities.r2_C: (KD - K_C) / (KD - K0), KD and K0 as in E68

control_hook.tolerance_basis: the hook must rebuild FT from W0 plus dW; a wrong sign or transpose reads about K_clean or more.
